svg.title: Challenge 194 selector evidence for sigma 0.9 and 1.0
svg.desc: Authenticated P0 plus extension v1 Q_G and four-sector means, standard errors, and unchanged interval marks; both sigma values remain unresolved.
svg.text: 挑战194：sigma 0.9 / 1.0 的 selector 实证
误差条：均值 ± 1 standard error；选择器只使用均值，不使用误差条救援。
状态：sigma = 0.9 与 sigma = 1.0 均为 requires_p0_extension；
Boundary: exploratory selector evidence only; not transition, scaling, exponent, or universality evidence.
